Name: Avatars in Grave Danger
Overview:
Zombified Avatars are on the loose, and they're hungry - for fun!

Defeat wave after wave of quirky zombies in this light-hearted wave defense game. Blast away 5 types of enemies using an upgradeable arsenal. Slow down time. Unlock over 50 Awards. Share your high scores and challenge your friends.

Will you triumph over all 20 waves? (Hint: Probably not!)
